key_reasoning.reason: BaseNode._add_output_key now takes a separate branch when clear_context_store is True, writing the output key as a list because the keep-new-only reducer path does not resolve append markers. This is a subtle workflow-state reducer contract, though no auth, security or performance surface is involved.

One node-layer fix (base_node.py), two workflow templates corrected so they pass save-time validation, and a new offline harness that exercises WorkflowExecutor.validate_workflow over the whole template corpus.
